ModMetaData.name: RimSiege
ModMetaData.author: BenFD
ModMetaData.description:
Medieval sieges that actually siege.
Vanilla sieges are mortars in a field. In RimSiege the enemy shows up with a plan: they demand a tribute first, and if you refuse they set up a war camp (banner, campfire, tents, stakes) and build their siege engines on site.
[b]What they bring[/b] - A battering ram for your gate. Crewed: kill the pushers and it stops. Double gates wont save you, it keeps going. - Or a siege tower that goes OVER your walls. The wall stays intact, the whole army climbs it one by one. - Trebuchet batteries (Medieval Overhaul), manned and reloaded from an ammo pile at the camp. - Sappers planting petards on a second wall while the ram hits the front. Pincer assaults. - A captain in a gilded helm, guarded by two bodyguards. Kill him before the breach and the whole siege routs - they even retreat back over their tower. - Capture the captain alive and his house sends a truce party to ransom him back, silver in hand. Execute him or let him rot and they swear a vendetta: the next siege comes sooner, angrier, and without an ultimatum.
Everything scales with threat points: small war parties just camp and charge on foot, late game sieges bring the full siege train. Settings page to tune all the thresholds.
[b]Counterplay[/b]: pay the tribute, raid the camp before the engines are built, kill the crews, burn the wooden engines, steal the trebuchet boulders, snipe the captain - or take him alive and sell him back to his own house.
[b]Requires Medieval Overhaul.[/b] Camping Tent optional (adds tents to the camp).
Siege tower and battering ram art by Tom.
BenFD
